subject: CloudForge bundle qualification + marketplace packaging next steps
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@cloudforge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudForge bundle spec + MAP (next steps)

Hi Marcus — great to meet you on the call earlier.

Per our discussion, CloudForge wants to ship a bundled offering that includes our observability layer + Redwood Inference credits as a joint SKU on AWS Marketplace (US first) and later GCP. We've attached a draft bundle spec and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP).

Can you confirm the minimum metadata/redwood evidence we need to include on the marketplace listing (security summary, pricing band, metering type)? Also interested in any standard co-sell activation commitments Redwood requires from ISVs for partner-led opportunities.

High-level asks from our side:
- SKU bundling template so our product team can map usage units -> Redwood metering
- SOC2 or equivalent evidence you require for a marketplace listing
- A point person for packaging/PRICING approval and co-sell routing (we flagged Ben on the call)
- A short timeline: we are targeting an initial listing by mid-June.

Attachments: cloudforge_bundle_spec.pdf, MAP-draft.xlsx

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
emily@cloudforge.io
(415) 555-0132

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudForge bundle spec + MAP (next steps)

Emily — thanks for the note and the materials. Good first pass.

Quick confirm: Redwood is happy to support an ISV-bundled SKU on AWS Marketplace provided the bundle maps to one of our metering patterns (per-token credits or per-invocation). We typically require: a short security summary (SOC2 type II attestation or equivalent), a reproducible SKU->metering mapping, pricing bands (list and renewal), and a partner addendum.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Ben to share the SKU mapping template and metering constraints (see attachment we use internally).
2) Emily/CloudForge to provide SOC2 summary and pricing sheet (Emily attached — will check).
3) Olga to assemble a Redwood evidence packet and marketplace-ready metadata checklist.
4) I will introduce your packaging lead to our AWS Marketplace contact for entitlement mapping and co-sell tagging.

Timeline: mid-June is aggressive but possible if we lock MAP this week and both sides commit to the evidence checklist within 7 business days.

Flags: if this will require a custom billing shim on our side (non-standard metering) we may need to scope a short engineering spike — that can add 2–3 weeks.

I'll start the intro to AWS and loop in legal for the addendum after we have the pricing bands.

--
Marcus Lin
Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.inference

Emily / Marcus — attaching the SKU mapping template we use for marketplace bundles. Two quick notes:

- Metering options: AWS supports usage-based (metering by units) or fixed-price subscriptions. For usage-based bundles we need a deterministic conversion from CloudForge units (observability metrics) -> Redwood inference credits. Please fill in column "metering_conversion" in the CSV.
- Billing reconciliation: if CloudForge wants to invoice customers and remit to Redwood, we need a signed reseller addendum. Otherwise marketplace metering will route usage directly and Redwood invoices per our standard terms.

I've attached sku-mapping-template.csv. Olga — can you flag any constraints from the catalog side (SKU length, description limits, evidence file size)?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Partner Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference

Attachments: sku-mapping-template.csv

From: Emily Zhang <emily@cloudforge.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul.nguyen@stratus-consulting.com>
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudForge bundle spec + MAP (next steps)

Thanks Ben — attached SOC2 summary and the preliminary pricing sheet.

Answers inline to the mapping template questions:
- metering_conversion: we propose 1 CloudForge analytics event = 0.25 Redwood inference credit (we can adjust after a pilot).
- billing preference: prefer marketplace metering to keep customer billing simple; open to reseller addendum if needed for specific channel deals.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Thu): finalize MAP and pricing bands
- Next Tue (16 May): provide completed SKU mapping file + SOC2 attestation PDF and any security attachments
- Following week (w/c 22 May): Redwood evidence packet + packaging kick-off with AWS rep

Attaching: CloudForge-SOC2-summary.pdf, pricing_sheet.xlsx

Emily Zhang
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge
emily@cloudforge.io

Emily — perfect, thanks for the SOC2 summary and timeline.

Olga — can you assemble the evidence-binder (redwood_marketplace_requirements.pdf + any internal catalog snippets)? Ben, please validate the metering_conversion offline and note any engineering spike required.

Action items for this thread:
- CloudForge: deliver completed sku-mapping-template.csv and final pricing_sheet.xlsx by EOD 16 May (Emily has committed).
- Redwood (Olga): prepare evidence-binder.zip and marketplace metadata checklist by 18 May.
- Ben: confirm whether the proposed 0.25 credit conversion requires a billing shim or is compatible with standard metering (reply 16 May).
- Marcus: will send DocuSign partner addendum link once pricing bands are confirmed.

I'll kick off the AWS intro now (cc'd).

Marcus Lin

Cc: Emily Zhang <emily@cloudforge.io>

Subject: Re: CloudForge bundle spec + MAP (next steps)

Thanks — assembling the evidence packet now. Checklist summary below and attaching evidence-binder.zip that contains the compacted artifacts we hand to marketplace teams.

Redwood evidence checklist (short):
- SOC2 attestation summary (CloudForge provided) — OK to link in listing.
- Short security blurb (<= 400 chars) — please provide CF-approved wording.
- Technical integration notes (how the SKU consumes Redwood credits) — CloudForge to populate sku-mapping-template.csv.
- Billing model and pricing bands — final pricing_sheet.xlsx required.
- Catalog metadata (long description + feature bullets) — CloudForge to supply final copy (max 2,500 chars).

Attachments in evidence-binder.zip: redwood_marketplace_requirements.pdf, small-catalog-snippet.json, sample-entitlement-policy.txt

Ben — on metering: the proposed 0.25 credit mapping should be compatible with our per-credit metering model as long as CloudForge exposes a post-aggregation conversion (i.e., CloudForge reports aggregated event count weekly). If they need per-invocation attribution back to us for revenue share, we will need the engineering spike (2 weeks) to add an attribution export. Recommend CloudForge start with marketplace metering and shift to reseller if they want consolidated invoicing.

Emily — please confirm the CloudForge catalog copy and whether you prefer marketplace direct metering or a reseller addendum for the initial launch. Once confirmed I'll upload the evidence package to the AWS private listing intake.

Olga Petrov
Catalog Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.inference
